elements.title: Domestic vs. Worldwide Gross

details.values: Scatter points distributed mostly clustered from (0,0) to about (400,1500), with some points extending up to about (900, 2700). Trend shows positive correlation between Domestic and Worldwide gross.

elements.summary: This scatterplot shows the relationship between Domestic and Worldwide gross revenues for movies, indicating a positive correlation where higher domestic gross tends to correspond to higher worldwide gross.
